description: This source file contains unit tests for the SpringBasedHonoPasswordEncoder class within the org.eclipse.hono.auth package. It verifies password encoding and matching functionalities across various hash algorithms (default, SHA-512, bcrypt), including handling malformed inputs.

classes.name: SpringBasedHonoPasswordEncoderTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for SpringBasedHonoPasswordEncoder, testing password matching logic.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test fixture by creating an instance of SpringBasedHonoPasswordEncoder with a specified iteration count.

methods.name: testMatchesFallsBackToDefaultHashFunction
methods.description: Tests that the encoder uses the default hash function if none is specified in the credentials.

methods.name: testMatchesSucceedsForCorrectPassword
methods.description: Verifies that a correct password matches a stored sha-512 hashed password.

methods.name: testMatchesSucceedsForMatchingBCryptPassword
methods.description: Verifies that a bcrypt hashed password can be correctly matched.

methods.name: testMatchesCredentialsFailsForNonMatchingPassword
methods.description: Checks that an incorrect password does not match the stored hash.

methods.name: testMatchesCredentialsFailsForMalformedPwdHash
methods.description: Ensures that malformed Base64 password hashes fail verification gracefully.

methods.name: testMatchesCredentialsFailsForMalformedSalt
methods.description: Ensures that malformed salt values in credentials cause verification to fail without throwing exceptions.

methods.name: getPasswordHash
methods.description: Utility method to create a hashed password string using specified hash function and salt.
